description: Revert to the proven aggressive configuration (Matrix LR 0.11, Embedding LR 1.4, Depth 10, Batch 128) which historically achieves the best convergence speed (~0.983 bpb) within the 5-minute budget, as the conservative LR (0.08) used in the current best run (0.9800) likely under-utilized the time by converging too slowly.
